provenance: ILLUSTRATIVE ASSUMPTIONS; no physical measurements or bought modules
notes: The OCV table is an invented smooth teaching curve, not a vendor pack curve or a way to estimate SOC from measured voltage.
6 Ah is before subtracting the 20% reserve. Runtime sweep assumes capacity has been correctly calibrated for each pack.
Efficiency includes all converter losses at the operating point; no additional quiescent term is added.
Copper path geometry comes from unchanged Rev B. Copper thickness and fixed temperature are assumed, not predicted.
Fuse resistances are manufacturer nominal cold values, not hot limits. AO3400A 48 milliohm is a room-condition data-sheet value at 2.5 V gate drive.
3 W constant-power loads are comparison references. Their input current can exceed 0.6 A after losses; start with smaller 2.5 W class loads and measure actual current.
The startup model uses voltage-dependent resistive fan demand and an instantaneous current-limited behavioural supply, not a purchased LM2596 loop/inductor or BLDC motor model.
The 4.75 V floor is a provisional project screening criterion, not a guaranteed ESP32 reset voltage or universal load specification.
